leads.title: Criminal Code and Another Act Amendment Act 1990
leads.documents: Decriminalisation of male same-sex activity in Queensland; repeal of anti-homosexuality offences.
leads.detail: Passed parliament 28 November 1990, royal assent 7 December 1990, took effect upon proclamation 19 January 1991; cited as implementing 1990 Parliamentary Criminal Justice Committee review recommending removal of homosexual offences and age 16 for private consensual conduct

leads.title: Queensland Criminal Code s208 - age of consent provisions / Health and Other Legislation Amendment Bill 2016
leads.documents: Unequal age of consent (16 for oral/vaginal vs 18 for anal/sodomy with up to 14 years imprisonment) and its 2016 equalisation to 16 for all forms.
leads.detail: Introduced by Minister Cameron Dick 16 June 2016; replaced 'sodomy' with 'anal intercourse'; passed 15 September 2016, royal assent 23 September 2016; notes 1996 Borbidge change from 'anal intercourse' to 'sodomy' and 2008 penalty increase by Attorney-General Kerry Shine

leads.title: Legal Affairs and Community Safety Committee report - 1 September 2016
leads.documents: Parliamentary review finding existing age-of-consent law discriminatory to same-sex attracted young men.
leads.detail: Tabled to parliament 1 September 2016 on Health and Other Legislation Amendment Bill 2016; found law 'particularly discriminatory to same-sex attracted young men and could inhibit their ability to receive advice on sexual health' and denied 'peer acceptance and community support'

leads.title: Queensland Law Reform Commission (QLRC) report - 31 August 2016 / Criminal Law (Historical Homosexual Convictions Expungement) Bill 2017
leads.documents: Expungement scheme for historical consensual homosexual and public morality offences and official apology machinery.
leads.detail: QLRC referred January 2016, reported 31 August 2016, tabled 29 November 2016; Bill introduced 11 May 2017, committee report 14 July 2017, passed 10 October 2017, assent 23 October 2017, Act and regulation in effect 30 June 2018; apology motion by Premier Annastacia Palaszczuk

leads.title: Discrimination Law Amendment Act 2002 / Acts Interpretation Act 1954
leads.documents: State anti-discrimination and de facto recognition of same-sex couples in 45+ pieces of Queensland legislation.
leads.detail: December 2002 reform; amended definition of 'de facto partner' in Acts Interpretation Act 1954 to include same-sex couples; factors for 'genuine domestic basis' listed; later expanded to 60+ pieces including superannuation, workers compensation, property, leave

leads.title: Civil Partnerships Bill 2011 / Civil Partnerships Act / Relationships Act 2011 / Relationships (Civil Partnerships) and Other Acts Amendment Bill 2015
leads.documents: Creation, downgrade, and restoration of civil partnership / registered relationship scheme for same-sex and opposite-sex couples.
leads.detail: Bill introduced 25 Oct 2011, passed 30 Nov 2011 47-40, assent 6 Dec 2011, commenced 23 Feb 2012; amended to 'registered relationships' 22 June 2012 69-8 effective 27 June 2012; restored by Relationships (Civil Partnerships) and Other Acts Amendment Act 2015 passed 3 Dec 2015 64-22, assent 17 Dec 2015, resumed 2 April 2016

leads.title: Marriage Amendment (Definition and Religious Freedoms) Act 2017
leads.documents: Federal legalisation of same-sex marriage applicable in Queensland and automatic recognition of overseas same-sex marriages.
leads.detail: Commenced 9 December 2017; first same-sex couple married in Queensland Craig Burns and Luke Sullivan just after midnight 9 January 2018; 2017 Australian Marriage Law Postal Survey 60.7% Yes in Queensland cited

leads.title: Adoption Act 2009 / Adoption and Other Legislation Amendment Bill 2016
leads.documents: Ban on same-sex adoption and its removal allowing single LGBTI people and same-sex couples to adopt from 11 November 2016.
leads.detail: 2009 Act required applicants be married/de facto and 'person's spouse is not the same gender'; 2016 Bill introduced 14 Sept 2016 by Minister Shannon Fentiman, committee reported 26 Oct 2016, debated 2 Nov with 43-43 division on eligibility clauses

leads.title: Human Rights and Equal Opportunity Commission (HREOC) - Same-Sex: Same Entitlements Inquiry
leads.documents: National Inquiry into Discrimination against People in Same-Sex Relationships recommending stepparent adoption reform.
leads.detail: Report entitled National Inquiry into Discrimination against People in Same-Sex Relationships; final report Same-Sex: Same Entitlements Inquiry tabled in Parliament 21 June 2007; recommended amending laws to recognise child and both same-sex parents

leads.title: Fitzgerald Inquiry / Criminal Justice Commission review / 1990 Parliamentary Criminal Justice Committee review
leads.documents: Government corruption inquiry leading to formal review recommending decriminalisation of homosexual activity.
leads.detail: Commissioned late 1980s; recommendation that newly established Criminal Justice Commission review laws governing voluntary sexual behaviour including homosexual activity; 1990 review recommended removal of homosexual offences and equal age 16; issue in 1989 state election with National leader Russell Cooper
